_comment: Curation manifest for the Dovetail -> persona-engine connector. Each raw entry is routed to a STREAM by its Dovetail project id. Rider behavioral interviews feed the persona-clustering engine; B2B/OEM voice is landed separately and must NOT be clustered on rider dimensions. Edit projects/skip rules here; the adapter is generic.

rider-personas.description: Rider behavioral interviews -> persona-analysis clustering engine (the P0 feed).

oe-voice.description: OEM / B2B integration interviews. Landed for the separate OE/channel analysis. NOT fed to rider clustering.
